claims.text: Stripe's Aug 19 newsroom post states it agreed to acquire OpenRouter, a model gateway/routing platform.
OpenRouter's companion post states it will continue operating with the same mission, name, product, and roadmap, and cites 10+ trillion tokens/day across 400+ models.
claims.context: Company-reported scale figures; not independently audited in captured bytes.

limitations.text: Transaction price/terms are not stated on either first-party page; widely reported $7-8B figures are press-reported and were not consumed as facts.
